scope: Ordinary directory-cache publication, checked blocking scans and frontend listing lifetime

native.reverted_change: Only jwalk successful root read_children.error() propagation replaced with the previous Ok(_) => {} branch; other fixes retained. This isolated chmod proof preceded the subsequent root-metadata error-context correction.

before.reason: Acknowledged chmod 000 navigation produced no visible error state.

cases: Missing-target error identifies the requested path while the prior committed breadcrumb remains
Visible permission error, followed by successful real marker listing after permissions restored
Mounted pane reattaches to replaced root while rejecting displaced-tree ghost entries
Existing-file external write updates preview and entry metadata
Directory lease reclamation across window destruction and renderer replacement
External file creation/deletion refreshes the listing
Watcher refresh coalescing preserves causal trailing refresh behavior

excluded_attempt.reason: Old known binary did not reach frontend page-session startup. No listing IPC or readiness marker; exact bootstrap cause unknown. Not counted as bug reproduction.

benchmark.interpretation: Same order of magnitude as historical result; no paired speedup or native startup claim. Subsequent debug-only timer gating does not change the benchmarked public scanner.

independent_reviews.models: Sol for all three subagents; Astra coordinates shared interfaces and integration
independent_reviews.rust: ACCEPT after restoring root metadata error context. Independent reviewer confirmed the narrow mapper and failing-before/passing-after contract; required final full Rust and rebuilt native runs both pass.
independent_reviews.frontend: ACCEPT after independent review found active-event and reentrant cleanup races; both have failing-before/passing-after regressions.

limitations: Cache caps 50 paths and 32 MiB of retained snapshot Vec/String allocation estimates, excluding caller Arcs, concurrent scans, allocator overhead and RSS.
Cache eviction still deallocates snapshots under its mutex; no hard latency bound or long-load contention measurement.
Pending eager listener acquisition releases eventually after cleanup, with no fully-drained cleanup-promise guarantee.
Cancellation acceptance proves one IPC attempt rather than backend reclamation after cancellation failure.
Browser fallback and serialized supersession lack new direct tests; a transition from browser to native runtime after fallback is not covered.
No deterministic real child metadata-failure injection through the parallel scanner; partial admission behavior is tested and diagnostic merging source-reviewed.
Initial listing/watch handoff remains unobserved until separately redesigned and accepted.
macOS half-bounce, Windows equivalents, larger native trees and long-session release acceptance remain outstanding.
